notes.title: HOTFIX1.0.0.2 (UI显示，超级采样，战斗人物消失）（UI,SSAA,missing character)
notes.content:
在研究了问题收集帖之后，我们决定推出紧急修复补丁


修复内容：

1.修复开场战斗中人物描述

2.修复超级采样问题

3.修复天王枪法问题

After researching into the feedback thread ,we have decide to push another patch.
 

FIX:

1.Fixed the UI text in intro battle.

2.Fixed the SSAA option.

3.Fixed the missing character in the intro battle.
